verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Jina Reader as a plain HTTP API (r.jina.ai/s.jina.ai) with curl examples, headers, and a 'code builder' tool, but no mention of official Python/JS/other SDKs or client libraries; probes for openapi spec and llms.txt both 404, suggesting no formal SDK/API surface is published. The axis applies (an API-first product plausibly ships SDKs) but no evidence supports it.
